definitions.name: Jinxed
definitions.description: A jinx clings to their hands — crafts crack, drops disappoint, and fortune's gifts arrive broken or hollow.

definitions.name: Unlucky
definitions.description: Luck runs against them; the good things of the world are usually just out of reach.

definitions.name: Average
definitions.description: No more and no less fortunate than the next cultivator — the ordinary odds of an ordinary life.

definitions.name: Lucky
definitions.description: A glint of fortune follows their hands — crafts come out right and rare finds turn up at just the right time.

definitions.name: Fortunate
definitions.description: Fortune smiles upon their ventures — good results and valuable finds arrive noticeably more often than not.

definitions.name: Heaven-Blessed
definitions.description: Heaven itself blesses their endeavors — fine crafts, rare drops and secret opportunities gather around them.

definitions.name: Fortune's Darling
definitions.description: Fortune itself dotes on them like a favored child — the extraordinary becomes their everyday norm.
